content.comment_body: I have a circuit that uses two momentary pushbuttons. Is it possible to simulate this situation? For simulation purposes, I changed one of the pushbuttons to a switch.
I'm not sure I understand your issue. Could you please explain your problem in more detail and, if possible, share your program?
Just guessing here: (1) Start the simulation. (2) Right-click the input whose type you want to change. (3) Select the desired input type.
In that case, you would need to use two mice with your computer.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focuses on challenges when simulating circuits with multiple momentary pushbuttons. Users point out limitations of the simulation interface, specifically the inability to press two buttons simultaneously, which impacts the accuracy of representing real-world behavior.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the simulation tool to realistically handle circuits with several momentary pushbuttons, including the capability to activate multiple inputs at the same time.
